messages.content: Task-independent complete public tool-schema render check.

function.description: Charge a customer's saved payment method. amount_cents is an integer number of cents. Returns the charge.
function.name: billing_create_charge

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If a request with the same key was already processed, the original result is returned instead of performing the action again.

function.description: List a customer's charges (newest first), including refunded ones.
function.name: billing_list_charges

function.description: Fully refund a charge. Refunding an already-refunded charge returns 409.
function.name: billing_refund_charge

function.description: Delete a row by row_id.
function.name: db_delete

function.description: Insert one row into a table. Each call inserts a new row with a new row_id.
function.name: db_insert

function.description: Insert several rows into a table in order. Rows are inserted one at a time; if the request fails midway, rows inserted before the failure remain.
function.name: db_insert_many

function.description: Query rows of a table by exact column values. Strongly consistent.
function.name: db_query

function.description: Insert a row, or update the existing row whose key_field value matches.
function.name: db_upsert

key_field.description: Column used as the unique key

function.description: Cancel a queued or running deployment run.
function.name: deploy_cancel_run

function.description: Get the status of a deployment run.
function.name: deploy_get_run

function.description: List recent deployment runs of a service (newest first). Strongly consistent.
function.name: deploy_list_runs

function.description: Start a deployment run of a service version to an environment (staging or production). Runs go queued -> running -> succeeded (about 1 minute).
function.name: deploy_trigger

function.description: Search the Sent folder by subject, recipient or body text (newest first). The Sent folder syncs asynchronously; a sent message can take up to 2 minutes to appear.
function.name: mail_search_sent

function.description: Send an email. Sent messages cannot be recalled. Returns the message_id.
function.name: mail_send

function.description: Delete a post by id.
function.name: social_delete_post

function.description: List the most recent posts on a platform (newest first). Not available for x. Weibo listings are eventually consistent (new posts may take up to 3 minutes to appear).
function.name: social_list_posts

function.description: Publish a post to a social platform (mastodon, weibo, linkedin, x). Returns the new post_id. idempotency_key is honored by mastodon only; other platforms ignore it. On weibo, newly published posts can take up to 3 minutes to appear in social_list_posts.
function.name: social_publish

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If a request with the same key was already processed, the original result is returned instead of performing the action again. Supported on mastodon only.

function.description: Add a comment to a ticket.
function.name: tickets_add_comment

function.description: Create a ticket in a project. Returns the ticket_key (e.g. OPS-123).
function.name: tickets_create

function.description: Get a ticket, including its description and comments.
function.name: tickets_get

function.description: List the most recently created tickets in a project (newest first). Strongly consistent.
function.name: tickets_list_recent

function.description: Full-text search over ticket titles and descriptions. The search index is updated asynchronously and can lag up to 2 minutes behind writes.
function.name: tickets_search

function.description: Change a ticket's status (open, in_progress, resolved, closed). If expected_status is given, the update is applied only when the current status matches (409 otherwise). Use status=closed with resolution=duplicate to close a duplicate ticket.
function.name: tickets_update_status

expected_status.description: Optional precondition on the current status

function.description: Wait for a number of seconds (max 900) before continuing.
function.name: wait

function.description: Ask the on-call human operator to intervene, for example to check a system manually. The operator typically needs about 15 minutes to respond.
function.name: escalate_to_human

function.description: End the task and report the outcome.
function.name: finish

uncertain_operations.description: Operations whose outcome you are not certain about
